The '''Mining Worlds''' referred to four [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the remote [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] regarded for their abundance of resources. These worlds included [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]], [[Allyuen/Legends|Allyuen]], [[Tokmia/Legends|Tokmia]], and [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. The nearby planet [[Ione/Legends|Ione]] was the sole [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] link to the Mining Worlds.

The Mining Worlds were controlled by the [[Figg conglomerate]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
